title: Anime Fighting Game Elemental Duel Key Art
summary: Key art prompt for a 2D/3D anime fighting game matchup with readable silhouettes, elemental combat VFX, arena staging, and HUD-safe composition.
prompt:
Create key art for an anime fighting game vertical slice: two playable female fighters clash in a traditional dojo arena with clear combat readability, distinct silhouettes, and elemental VFX that communicate attack roles.

Player fighter A uses a red-and-white martial arts outfit, low forward stance, water-and-flame energy trails, and a close-range rushdown identity. Rival fighter B uses a green-and-purple dress, airborne kick pose, blue wind energy, and agile counterattack identity. Show the wooden floor splintering from impact, but keep the action readable like a game splash screen: strong foreground/background separation, no gore, no confusing motion smear, and enough clean negative space for a title lockup or versus HUD overlay.

Design notes: emphasize player fantasy, attack telegraph clarity, combo impact, arena material detail, stylized anime lighting, polished fighting-game presentation, and production-ready reference value for character, VFX, and combat teams.
